title: Opulent Nostalgia
description: Un style photographique cinématographique vintage imitant le film 35 mm avec un flash frontal direct. Il présente une esthétique maximaliste, un grain de film prononcé et un doux halo, contrastant des sujets pastel avec des ombres profondes, chaudes et encombrées.
description_en: A vintage cinematic photographic style mimicking 35mm film with direct frontal flash. It features a maximalist aesthetic, heavy film grain, and soft halation, contrasting pastel subjects against deep, warm, cluttered shadows.
description_fr: Un style photographique cinématographique vintage imitant le film 35 mm avec un flash frontal direct. Il présente une esthétique maximaliste, un grain de film prononcé et un doux halo, contrastant des sujets pastel avec des ombres profondes, chaudes et encombrées.
prompt: Vintage 35mm editorial film photography. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. The lighting utilizes a harsh, direct frontal flash that flattens the immediate foreground while casting sharp, dense drop shadows behind elements. This flash contrasts heavily with deep, warm, moody ambient lighting in the background, creating a rapid light fall-off and a natural vignette. Colors feature high-exposure {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}} tones that pop intensely under the flash, offset by rich, dark background shadows and shimmering {{accent_color}} specular highlights. The texture is distinctly analog, characterized by heavy film grain, slight color shifting in the shadows, and soft halation blooming around bright or reflective surfaces. Edges are photographic and slightly soft, with a shallow depth of field blurring the cluttered, maximalist background elements into a moody bokeh. Materiality emphasizes a contrast between matte, plush textures and glossy, reflective accents. The overall atmosphere is nostalgic, opulent, and slightly melancholic. 35mm film, direct flash, vintage editorial, heavy grain, halation, maximalist, kitsch aesthetic, opulent shadows, glowing highlights, sharp foreground, blurred background, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame.

video.motion: Subjects exhibit slow, deliberate movements while specular highlights and reflections subtly glint and shift across glossy surfaces.
video.camera: A static camera or a very slow, smooth push-in that maintains the shallow depth of field.
video.temporal_texture: Analog film grain must boil consistently across frames, while halation around bright areas pulses softly with movement.
video.avoid: Avoid fast cuts, digital sharpness, modern LED lighting aesthetics, or perfectly clean, noise-free rendering.
